Location: Remote (LATAM, Eastern Europe, Pakistan, and South Africa Preferred)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Ruby on Rails Developer to build, optimize, and maintain scalable web applications that power growing businesses and modern SaaS products.

This role is ideal for an engineer who has deep expertise in the Ruby on Rails ecosystem and enjoys building reliable, secure, and high-performing applications. You’ll work across backend architecture, APIs, databases, and application performance while collaborating closely with product, engineering, and design teams to deliver production-ready features.

If you’re passionate about clean code, scalable architecture, and taking ownership from development through deployment, this is an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Schedule: Flexibility for sprint reviews, deployments, and occasional on-call support

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Ruby on Rails Developer to build, maintain, and scale modern web applications and APIs.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on:

  • Ruby on Rails development
  • Backend systems and REST APIs
  • PostgreSQL / MySQL
  • Background jobs with Sidekiq or Resque
  • Application performance and scalability
  • Testing and code quality
  • Third-party integrations
  • Production reliability

You’ll collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend engineers to ship secure, scalable, and maintainable features.

If you have 3+ years of professional Ruby on Rails experience and enjoy writing clean, well-tested code, this role is a strong fit.<
